test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following will fill blank no (2)
solution:
The correct answer is '**devices**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage mentions that not all students have equal access to reliable internet or digital ____.
 
• The blank needs a word that fits with "reliable internet" and refers to a physical means of accessing digital content.
 
• "**Devices**" (such as laptops, tablets, or smartphones) is the most appropriate choice, as these are essential for digital learning.
 
• Other options ("**curriculum**", "**storage**", "**textbooks**") do not fit contextually with internet access or digital learning tools.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Passage Excerpt: *Not all students have equal access to reliable internet or digital **devices__**, which creates a significant learning gap.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Curriculum: Refers to course content, not something students need physical access to.
 
• Storage: Implies digital or physical storage, which does not fit with internet access.
 
• Textbooks: Traditional learning resources, not digital tools required for online learning.
